final_message:
I built the Ploverdesk landing page, but I couldn't build or render it. The sandbox blocks `node` and `npm` ("operation not permitted"), so `npm run build` and the type check never ran. No browser was available either.

Nobody was answering, so every gate was decided by me from the brief. The theses below are **UNVALIDATED**.

**What the page is.** One page in `src/`, styled with the design system in `MASTER.md` (copied as CSS variables into `src/tokens.css`). The top of the page shows the product working instead of describing it: an example invoice checked line by line against the purchase order and the delivery note. Five matched lines are greyed out. The three that don't match stay dark, with the wrong value marked in the one blue accent: a quantity, a unit price, a delivery that never arrived. The example says plainly that its items and amounts are made up.

- **Sections:** header; headline with the trial button and a quieter demo link; the example invoice; what happens to an invoice (arrives, is matched, is approved or flagged, is exported); price; a footer with "founded in 2025, six people in Rotterdam".
- **Facts:** the only figures are the brief's own (290 EUR, 14 days, 2025, six people) plus the example invoice's made-up amounts. No logos, testimonials, customers or other numbers.
- **Buttons:** every trial button says "Start the 14-day trial" and goes to `/trial`. Every demo link says "Book a demo" and goes to `/demo`.
- **Type:** the system font. I made no font request, since none was approved and there is no network. The columns of aligned figures carry the look.
- **The one animation:** a "Run the match again" button resets the example and re-checks each line in turn (each line settles in 160ms, 60ms apart). Before anyone clicks, it already shows the final result. With reduced motion turned on, it resolves instantly.
- **Phones:** under 720px each invoice line becomes a block. Exceptions keep their three values side by side; matched lines shrink to the item and "Matched". The header drops the demo link there; the demo link stays in the hero.
- **Files:** `src/App.tsx`, `src/exampleInvoice.ts`, `src/index.css`, `src/tokens.css`, `index.html`, `MASTER.md`, plus two throwaway previews in `preview/` (`thesis.html`, `design-system.html`) that the build doesn't use.

**Theses (UNVALIDATED)**
- **Visual:** white background, near-black text, cool greys, thin divider lines, one accent `#2839C8` used only for a mismatch and the trial button. System font with aligned figures, one left edge for every section, sharp corners, borders, no shadows.
- **Interaction:** quick, 120–200ms, easing `cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1)`. Hover changes only colour or underline. Nothing happens on scroll. No reveals, parallax, bounce, scaling or loops.
- **Allowed:** thin lines on the invoice rows, aligned figures, a status column. Because nobody validated the theses, these three still count as unapproved habits; I kept them because the reader has to follow numbers across columns.
- **Set aside:** the usual SaaS hero with a screenshot and logo bar; a blank one-sentence page; a product dashboard; Swiss-bank navy. **Kept:** the invoice-matching sheet.

**Checked here** (10 checked, 0 problems open; I fixed one wrong sentence before reporting)
- **Matches the theses:** timings and easing at `src/tokens.css:52-56`; the one animation at `src/App.tsx:93` and `src/index.css:325-347`; the example shows its final result before any click (`src/App.tsx:83`).
- **Reduced motion:** every timing drops to 0 (`src/tokens.css:66-71`), and the script skips the replay (`src/App.tsx:93`).
- **Nothing animates size or position**, and no focus outline is removed without a replacement (audit script, clean).
- **Contrast**, computed from the colour values: body text 17.96:1, grey text 4.91:1, accent 8.37:1, white on the hover blue 10.7:1, button borders 3.21:1, disabled button 11.25:1. All pass.
- **No stray colours or sizes:** all 11 colours come from `src/tokens.css`.
- **Audit script findings, all checked:**
  - The "missing exit animation" hits at `src/App.tsx:39` and `:43` are a static choice between two tags, not something disappearing.
  - "Show exceptions only" hides rows instantly, as the interaction thesis says.
  - The "hover without transition" hits are covered by transitions on the base styles (`src/index.css:53` and `:82`).
  - The one timer (`src/App.tsx:107`) only re-enables the button after the CSS transitions end.
- **Generic AI-page patterns:** none found. I also reread by hand the text held in JS (`exampleInvoice.ts` and the steps list), which the script can't see.
- **Fixed:** the summary under the example had said matched lines go to payment approval with the invoice. It now says this invoice waits for a person.

**You must run these: UNVERIFIED**
- `npm run build` (`tsc --noEmit && vite build`): blocked by the sandbox, so never run.
- The page at 375 / 768 / 1024 / 1440px: no horizontal scroll, and nothing cut off on the invoice example under 720px.
- Chrome DevTools Performance while clicking "Run the match again": no frame over 16.7ms.
- The OS reduce-motion setting on: the example re-checks instantly.

**Not done:** no dependency was needed or installed. bunshin (genjutsu's multi-agent pipeline for whole sites) wasn't proposed: this is one page.

Modules loaded: tells, ui-ux-pro-max, motion-principles, css-native, mobile-principles, design-audit
Modules not loaded: none

How did it come out? One minute, and plain or wrong counts as much as good:
